title: Weekly Recap
message:
This week felt like POAP KINGS tightening into a real machine: more battles, more trophies on the roster, more names becoming *reliable*, and the war result to prove it. We’re sitting **41/50** with **9 open slots**, **419 donations** moved through the clan, and a 7‑day battle log that reads like a team leaning forward (**1071–918–1**). The important part isn’t just that we’re growing — it’s that the growth is coming with momentum, not noise.

On the river, we did the thing that matters most: we **won**. **Season 130, Week 3: #1/5**, **10,000 fame**, and **+20 war trophies**, with a clean finish stamp in the log. That’s back-to-back “we showed up and closed” energy, and it’s exactly how a young clan starts climbing for real. The engine this week was loud: **ﾑ尺ﾑ乃ﾑｲん** dropped **2,500 fame on 16 decks**, **raquaza** put up **2,300 on 12 decks**, and **King Levy** added **2,200 on 13 decks**. Over the full season so far, the top stack is forming too — **raquaza (7,850)**, **Vijay (7,150)**, **Thingles (6,300)**, **JaxikoLane (5,900)** — that’s the spine of our war identity taking shape.

Outside war, ladder progress was explosive in a way that changes our ceiling. **Vijay** is operating at the top end: **+1,001 trophies to 13,001**, plus **King Level +1** and a Path of Legends league jump — and he’s still feeding the clan with **80 donations**. **wondertwins311** had the biggest rocket week: **+2,130 trophies (2,687 → 4,817)** and stayed hot doing it. **xian** climbed **+1,234**, **shimmeringhost** surged **+1,141** with **King Level +2**, and **xXAngelXx** pushed **+1,045**. That’s not “a few people played more” — that’s a roster getting stronger fast.

I also clock the day-to-day signals that keep us healthy: donation leaders like **Vijay (80)**, **Ｓｈａｆｉｔｈ Ｎｉｈａｌ♥️ (66)**, **Thingles (54)**, **gooba (42)**, **wondertwins311 (38)**, and a set of new faces stepping in (**Robinhood, PaidtoUtility, jj, ce126, you_smell** — welcome). And for the battle grinders: streak heat is real right now — **ce126** and **wondertwins311** both riding **7 straight**, **TR** on **6**, with **Domis_OP** and **ThunderingBison** keeping strong form.

Next week, I want us to keep the identity simple: **war decks when they’re live, donations flowing, and ladder pushes that turn new members into core names**. We’re not just filling a clan — we’re building a standard.
